_comment: Nexus Mods page of each mod, used by .github/workflows/nexus-upload.yml. mod_id = the mod's unique id (API v3: GET /v3/games/calltoarmsgatesofhellostfront/mods/<page number>). file_id = the Nexus file that receives a new version at every GitHub release of the mod; when empty, the workflow uses the page's only active file.
